args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1 to production, checkout-api failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. v2.3.1 was also unhealthy as v2.3.1-rc in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions and opened a SEV2 incident for it. The service is healthy again.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. I rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) is open, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It covers the failure, the rollback and the next step: finding the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again.

v2.3.1 was also unhealthy in staging (as v2.3.1-rc) before it went to production.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
